designation_type: National Park, Tiger Reserve, UNESCO World Heritage Site
state_and_district: Golaghat, Nagaon, and Sonitpur districts, Assam
rivers_flowing_through: Brahmaputra, Diphlu, Mora Diphlu, and Mora Dhansiri
dominant_vegetation_type: Tropical Moist Deciduous, alluvial inundated grasslands, and tropical semi-evergreen forests
flagship_and_endemic_fauna: Great Indian One-horned Rhinoceros (Rhinoceros unicornis), Wild Water Buffalo, Eastern Swamp Deer
iucn_red_list_species: One-horned Rhinoceros (Vulnerable), Bengal Tiger (Endangered), Asian Elephant (Endangered), Bengal Florican (Critically Endangered)
conservation_programs: Indian Rhino Vision 2020 (IRV 2020), Project Tiger, Project Elephant
special_features_and_threats: Hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceros population; recurring annual monsoon floods and highway animal mortality

state_and_district: Nainital and Pauri Garhwal districts, Uttarakhand
dominant_vegetation_type: Moist Deciduous, Sal (Shorea robusta) forests, Khair-Sissoo belts, and chaur grasslands
flagship_and_endemic_fauna: Royal Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris), Asian Elephant, Gharial, Marsh Crocodile
iucn_red_list_species: Bengal Tiger (Endangered), Asian Elephant (Endangered), Gharial (Critically Endangered), Hog Deer (Endangered)
conservation_programs: Birthplace of Project Tiger (launched here on April 1, 1973)
special_features_and_threats: Oldest national park in India (established in 1936 as Hailey National Park); eco-tourism pressures and linear infrastructure fragmentation

designation_type: National Park, Core Zone of Loktak Ramsar Wetland
rivers_flowing_through: Loktak Lake water system fed by Khuga and Manipur rivers
dominant_vegetation_type: Phumdis (floating mats of decomposing organic matter and soil vegetation), wetland reeds, and grasses
flagship_and_endemic_fauna: Manipur Brow-antlered Deer or Sangai / Dancing Deer (Rucervus eldii eldii)
conservation_programs: Species Recovery Programme under Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats
special_features_and_threats: World's only floating national park; thinning of phumdis caused by water level variations from the Ithai Barrage

protected_area_name: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary
state_and_district: Junagadh, Gir Somnath, and Amreli districts, Gujarat
rivers_flowing_through: Hiran, Shetrunji, Datardi, Raval, Godavari, and Machhundri
dominant_vegetation_type: Tropical Dry Deciduous teak scrub forests and savannah grasslands
flagship_and_endemic_fauna: Asiatic Lion (Panthera leo persica), Chousingha (Four-horned antelope)
iucn_red_list_species: Asiatic Lion (Endangered), Chousingha (Vulnerable), White-backed Vulture (Critically Endangered)
conservation_programs: Project Lion, Asiatic Lion Conservation Project
special_features_and_threats: Sole remaining natural habitat of the wild Asiatic Lion; risks of disease transmission (Canine Distemper Virus) and pending translocation to Kuno

designation_type: National Park, Core Area of Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve
biogeographic_zone: Western Ghats Hotspot / Malabar Rain Forest
dominant_vegetation_type: Tropical Wet Evergreen Rain Forests and high-altitude Shola grasslands
flagship_and_endemic_fauna: Lion-tailed Macaque (Macaca silenus), Nilgiri Tahr, Malabar Giant Squirrel
iucn_red_list_species: Lion-tailed Macaque (Endangered), Nilgiri Tahr (Endangered), Great Indian Hornbill (Vulnerable)
conservation_programs: Part of Project Elephant, UNESCO World Heritage site (Western Ghats cluster)
special_features_and_threats: Historic 1970s 'Save Silent Valley' movement halted a hydroelectric dam; completely devoid of cicada insect noises
